notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima's Student do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Sakashima's Student.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Sakashima's Student.
Activate Sakashima's Student by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
